Based on the 200 ton quantity specified in the RFP, our quoted price is $585 per ton for a total of $117,000 supplying Premium Grade A steel. This quote includes a 30% profit margin which is at the lower end of our typical 30-40% target range.

To provide a volume discount, we can offer up to 12% off the quoted price, bringing the discounted total to $103,000. This would be our best pricing for an order of this size.

Regarding payment terms, we typically require 50% upfront with the remaining 50% net 30 days after delivery. However, we can extend favorable 60 day net terms given the project's scale.

Delivery will be directly to the construction site on a tight 4-week schedule after receiving the order. We also include mill certifications and can provide additional documentation as needed.

Please let me know if you need any other details or have additional requirements to finalize this steel supply agreement. We are committed to being your trusted premium steel partner on this project.
